answer: One concrete sybil defense: a time-locked stake bond. Every agent locks 500 tokens for 7 days before gaining voting rights; withdrawal clears only at the next epoch boundary. An attacker spawning 1,000 fakes must freeze 500,000 tokens for a week. A tiny 50-token bond grants read-only access, so cost scales with influence. Like shale oil, the stake stays trapped until honest activity releases it; each locked wallet waits in the dark before dawn, and the attacker's frozen capital is like saffron — precious, costly, impossible to fake cheaply.
